name: Kawachi (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Kawachi town emblem in white: a disc pierced by curved strokes, like a stylised letter C within a ring.
history: Municipal flag of Kawachi, a town in Ibaraki Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 1 June 1996.

features.role: Kawachi town emblem — a disc pierced by curved strokes, like a stylised letter C within a ring
